Value is spread across many small items; the most worthwhile are the two metal detectors (check brand/model, batteries, coils, whether they are working), the Holly Hobbie sewing machine (about $35-95), and the large RC tank (check it runs, comes with controller; tank search finds only new Heng Long models, so unsure of its brand). Searches for a Cobra-brand tank and for White's hipmount units returned no rows. Prices mostly within 3 years; Holly Hobbie prices flat to slightly up in 2025-26.
